args.prompt:
Create ONE landscape 1536x1024 transparent PNG character sheet: EXACTLY SIX different KFB SLOPS, cartoon handmade claymation ink blob AUTO AND JETPACK MECHANICS, 3 columns x 2 rows, six entire separate silhouettes, generous transparent gutters and clear margins per cell, no overlaps. All three attached originals are STYLE REFERENCES, not edit targets: first for expressive monstrous black-purple ink splat morphology, second and third for charming chunky hand-modeled occupational props and tactile clay craft. Preserve their visceral cartoony handmade monster appeal and bold physical prop design. New designs, do not duplicate their uniform angry faces. Deep charcoal violet soft thick goo volumes, irregular teeth, rubbery sculpted lips, asymmetric lobes, expressive big eyes with WHITE/IVORY sclera, RED iris and BLACK pupil. Footless complete blobs, no humanoid torso or legs. Retro 1930s-1950s sci-fi dieselpunk workshop flavor: worn petrol teal, mustard, rust red, brass, riveted clay steel. Each only 1-2 bold readable occupational props, practical recognizable tools with playful cartoon proportions. Each has unique silhouette, mouth and attitude. Three female-read mechanics through varied subtle lashes, clay quiff or tied headscarf and acting, no breasts or human bodies.
Top left: FEMALE-READ stocky hot-rod engine mechanic, short red tied headscarf, gleefully toothy sideways smirk, hefty wrench turning a big bolt on a compact exposed cartoon V-twin engine held against her goo body; large simple rounded cylinders, two curved exhausts.
Top center: tall narrow test-pilot jetpack tinkerer, eccentric goggles pushed up, HUGE delighted open-mouthed cackle and red pupils looking backward; wears a beautifully chunky twin-cylinder riveted teal rocket pack with broad conical exhaust bells and two SHORT thick sculpted orange clay flame puffs, hands holding a single spanner. Footless goo outline always visible.
Top right: FEMALE-READ compact tire mechanic, purple goo victory-roll quiff, half-lidded unimpressed sideways gaze, crooked closed mouth with one tooth; hefts one oversized worn hot-rod tire with cream hub, one elbow resting on its tread, no other equipment. Tire genuinely round with bold cartoon tread.
Bottom left: broad low puddle welder, lifted rounded welding mask, one eye squinting and lopsided tongue-out concentrated face; one thick retro welding torch aimed at a small detached curved rusty jetpack exhaust nozzle, just three bold sculpted spark shapes at contact. Strong chunky clay prop modeling.
Bottom center: FEMALE-READ pear-shaped jetpack fuel specialist, teal headscarf, wide mischievous eyes, delighted asymmetrical fang smile; embraces one bulbous brass-and-red retro rocket fuel can with a thick flexible pouring spout, one large oily black drop suspended at the spout. No labels or symbols, simple beautiful can form.
Bottom right: grizzled squat carburetor mechanic, heavy low lids and deeply grumpy underbite, sparse ivory teeth, battered leather aviator cap; cradles a big rounded cartoon carburetor with brass intake trumpet and one red adjustment knob, short screwdriver in other hand.
All six physically expressive and charmingly weird, direct bodily relationship to beautifully modeled familiar props, not elaborate visual riddles. Vary wide/short/tall shape, gaze and mouth genuinely, no six grin clones. Rich softly modeled clay, subtle fingerprints and stopmotion imperfections, warm upper-left studio light. True transparency, no floor or shadow disks, no environment, no gradients, no fake checkerboard, no captions or typography. Keep every full character and prop in its own independent grid cell with generous blank border.
